item.title: What is happening with Go?
item.description:
Introduction

In fact nothing special is happening with Go, I just wanted to get your attention but I swear you won’t waste your time. Today we will talk about reverse engineering and we will dig into the guts of Go binaries. Be ready !

For context, Go is a high level language designed by Google in 2007. In the beginning the goal was to have something easier than C++ and something that compiles quickly.

item.title: Hiding a video inside a video (mp4)
item.description:
Context

A steganography challenge using an MP4 file to hide data. Made for Jeanne d’Hack CTF, capture the flag which take place in Rouen.

The sources and solve script for the challenge are available here.

The Pitch

Link is trapped in a time loop by the Calamity. He has been opening this chest for eternity, yet it remains hopelessly empty. It is up to you to analyze this dream and extract its true contents.

item.title: A way to hide data in GIF files
item.description:
Context

A steganography challenge using a GIF file to hide data, created for the Jeanne d’Hack CTF, a capture-the-flag competition that takes place in Rouen.

The sources and solve script for the challenge are available here.

The Pitch

You are on vacation in a distant country, but you’ve forgotten your hotel room password… You wander through the city, hoping it will eventually come back to you.

The flag is hidden within the data of the goofy_fantasy.gif file. You must study the GIF file structure to find it.

item.title: Magic Maze
item.description:
Context

A Pwn (Binary Exploitation) challenge focused on a Format String vulnerability. Made for Jeanne d’Hack CTF, capture the flag which take place in Rouen.

The sources for the challenge are here : https://github.com/shennmue/ctf_challenges/tree/main/pwn/Magic%20Maze

The Pitch

A developer friend of yours found a box containing the first video games he ever coded, and among them was Magic Maze. The name caught your attention, and you decided to try it out when you got home…

item.title: Draconophobia
item.description:
A Pwn (Binary Exploitation) challenge focused on heap corruption. Made for Jeanne d’Hack CTF, capture the flag which take place in Rouen.

The sources for the challenge are here : https://github.com/shennmue/ctf_challenges/tree/main/pwn/draconophobia

The Pitch

You and your friend have been sent on a mission to defeat the mountain dragon. This quest will reward you with experience points and fame. Do you accept it?

Objective

The goal of this challenge is to analyze and exploit the provided binary to successfully trigger the lvl_up function and read the contents of the flag.txt file.

item.title: CTF experience
item.description:
Since two years ago, I’ve had the opportunity to design challenges for the Jeanne d’Hack CTF, a capture the flag competition that takes place in Rouen. I had already participated in CTF’s, but seeing the inside and discovering how the infrastructure is handled is a completely different experience!

Here are some of the challenges I created:

PWN

  • Magic Maze
  • Draconophobia

Steganography

  • Hiding a video inside a video (mp4)
  • A way to hide data in GIF files
  • MP4 “obfuscation”

Check out the official CTF website: Jeanne d’Hack

item.title: Who am I ?
item.description:
Hey! If you are reading this, maybe you want to know more about me. Here is my character card:

  • Name: Ali HAMMOUDI
  • Studies: Master’s degree in cybersecurity at the University of Rouen Normandie
  • Age: 22 years old
  • Interests: A lot of things: electronics, low-level stuff, steganography on video and audio file format, video games (playing and dev), hiking, mangas.
  • My goal in life: Build my own company in reverse engineering/pentesting in a few years! But for the moment, I still have a lot to learn.
  • Favorite animal: Blue whale I guess, so majestic.
  • The purpose of this blog: Show some of my favorite works, projects, and ideas to have a place where everything is gathered!
